purpose: Render a lightweight semantic table for readable summaries and comparison data.
accessibility: Keep native table, caption, header, row, and cell semantics available to the consumer.
Use TableHead scope to identify column or row headers and preserve readable focus order.
responsive: Uses a bounded horizontal scroll owner when content exceeds the viewport.
Keeps semantic rows and columns intact instead of switching to an unrelated card layout.
motion: Uses shared row and surface transitions only where state changes.

api.name: className
api.description: Additional class for the semantic table.
